Enforced twice in MessagesResource.render_post: raw len(payload) > cap -> 4.13 REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE before decode (deaddrop error style), and final expanded body string > cap -> 4.00 BAD_REQUEST before ANY state mutation (covers canned-catalog expansion inflation).
